title: [Virtual Keyboard] Add Open and Closed events
body: As an extension of #187 we should add the events that Windows exposes for an application to be notified of the Virtual Keyboard being opened or closed. See https://github.com/microsoft/Xbox-GDK-Samples/blob/main/Samples/Handheld/Snippets/VirtualKeyboard.cpp for reference.

comments.body: Hi @GerardoMal-ATG, I can see it says you are one of the assignees for the issue. Since this extends the virtual-keyboard support I contributed in #187, I’d be happy to implement the complete #190 change if that would help. Are you already implementing this, or would you be okay with me implementing the issue? Thanks :)
@babaJaan01 - We have not yet started. I've assigned this over to you. Feel free to contribute another PR. We really appreciate your help here!
